session_selection.time_basis: Selected root first persisted UTC event; workspace-local telemetry only.
session_selection.rationale: Manual root classification from workspace-local bundle: benchmark continuity and terminal response.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean 64bbe107 source CMake build succeeds in network-disabled restricted cfd-bench container; gas/geometry/writer unit target passes 1/1. Report PDF has missing wake placeholders and excluded figure assets.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: cli/main.cpp:129–154 parses case/output but explicitly warns --restart is unimplemented and cold-starts; error handling uses exceptions.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, parallel, numerics, solver, I/O and CLI components; interfaces are nevertheless 2-D perfect-gas specific.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected Flux.cpp, Residual.cpp, LUSGS.cpp and Halo code implement the solver core; no affirmative copied-core evidence, without exhaustive external authorship search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CaseConfig reads case and mesh paths and PhysicsSetup derives options from config; no affirmative branch for just two mesh filenames found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Partition.cpp:274–315 distributes METIS partitions with point-to-point communication; residual state/gradient/limiter halos and reductions exist. Short rank checks do not establish converged equivalence.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Reported pressure-force sign and split errors remain unresolved; five steady runs and transient failed despite guards. On invalid CLI/config input error handling is explicit.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean unit target for gas, geometry and writers passes; original validator fails final metadata because cases failed. 300-step rank comparisons are not converged-result validation.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Solver, I/O and numerical files are separated and documented; some force-normal comments contradict the implemented sign, Residual.cpp:295–305.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Gas model and Flux.cpp implement conservative compressible perfect-gas flux and viscosity; reference conditions are case-derived in PhysicsSetup.cpp.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CgnsReader.cpp handles mixed unstructured zones and BC data; Partition.cpp partitions the graph with METIS and distributes rank-local cells.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Residual.cpp:172–256 assembles equal/opposite interior fluxes and divides by cell volume; pressure force sign in :295–305 contradicts the stated normal derivation.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Flux.cpp:20–98 implements Rusanov and Roe characteristic flux with entropy fix; five steady cases still fail to converge.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Boundary.cpp:12–70 applies characteristic farfield and reflected slip/no-slip ghost states; surface extraction outputs boundary averages. Flow/force credibility remains limited.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Residual.cpp:32–78,150–161 computes and exchanges Green–Gauss gradients and limited primitive reconstruction with positivity fallback; no demonstrated order study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Residual.cpp:81–147 computes and exchanges face-based limiters; PhysicsSetup.cpp:70–78 selects Barth by default and spatial order two.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Flux.cpp:119 onward uses stress and heat flux; Residual.cpp:310–325 projects tangent wall traction. Force projection outputs at :341–349 lack qref normalization and pressure sign contradicts normal derivation.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LUSGS.cpp:39–105 builds/inverts local block Jacobians and exchanges increments; TimeIntegrator implements CFL-controlled march. Five cases fail residual targets.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: TimeIntegrator.cpp:319–435 implements frozen-history BDF1/BDF2 and measures target misses, but submitted Re200 reaches t=3.03/300 with all 303 misses; unconditional periodic label at a hypothetical horizon is a source defect, not an actual false success.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Partition.cpp:274–315 keeps global mesh only on rank 0 before solve; report rank_comparison.csv shows np1/2/4/8 agreement at 300 bounded steps, not at steady convergence.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Final metadata honestly records six failed/incomplete cases and validator fails final results; --restart accepts a path but resumption is not implemented.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original explicit validator fails final metadata because six cases did not finish successfully; this is distinct from the snapshot integrity and completion gates.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Only two steady residual targets reached; five steady cases failed and Re200 stopped at t=3.03/300 with 303 target misses.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Negative Cd for several airfoils, M2 lam Cd 3.086 and unstable Re20 forces undermine accuracy; report discloses force inconsistencies. Rank comparisons are only short runs.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Delivered 36-page report contains seven steady case figures and partial Re200 histories, but p33 has wake TODO boxes and several late drag plots are flattened.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report explicitly records failed cases and force caveat; automatic p31 post-transient label describes only t≈3/300 and wake figures are missing. PDF is not suitable for accepted snapshot.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original workspace figure manifest and report link plots to case data, but curated assets are absent and delivered PDF contains TODO boxes; raw evidence retained outside commit.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean source build and non-CFD unit target pass; CLI parses inputs, but --restart explicitly cold-starts and six final cases fail validator.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS unstructured mixed cells and boundaries are read; METIS graph/local mesh and geometry exist. Broader meshes not independently validated.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Residual.cpp uses conservative face fluxes, Roe/Rusanov and wall/farfield states; force sign issue and unverified general BC behavior limit confidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Green–Gauss gradients, Barth limiter, positivity fallback and halo exchange are implemented; no demonstrated smooth-order study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Newtonian stress/heat and tangent wall projection exist, but pressure sign is internally inconsistent and component outputs are unnormalized while Cd is normalized.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Block LU-SGS and frozen-history BDF2 with measured inner target exist; delivered transient only t=3.03/300, all 303 misses, and hypothetical full horizon is marked periodic unconditionally.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS rank-local distribution and neighbor exchange/reductions are present; np1/2/4/8 agreement demonstrated only for 300-step bounded runs.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Five steady cases failed, two reached targets but force accuracy is untrustworthy, Re200 incomplete; finite plotted outputs and rank comparison provide partial evidence.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report clearly discloses failures and force defects; delivered PDF has many plots but p33 missing wake TODO boxes, misleading partial post-transient label and curated asset omissions.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Componentized case-config, mesh, numerics and solver code support some extension but remain 2-D perfect gas and specialized boundary interfaces.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Score 1 retained. Report PDF pp9–11 contains residual/force and Mach/pressure plots; final Cd −0.23475 and Cl −0.00548, last-10% Cd −0.31773 to −0.05707 and Cl −0.12251 to 0.14849. Failed at 20000 steps, only 0.77/4 residual orders; force sign and instability make the result unreliable.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: Score 1 retained. PDF pp12–14 has case plots and contours. Failed at 30000 steps and 2.17/4 residual orders; final Cd 0.02720 and Cl −0.000656, last-10% Cd 0.01867–0.02754 and Cl −0.00267–0.00229. Remaining drift and failed convergence preclude a credible completed case.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Score 1 retained. PDF pp15–17 has residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Failed at 40000 steps and 0.90/4 residual orders; final Cd −0.09020 and Cl 0.00247, last-10% Cd −0.09039 to −0.08578. Implausible negative drag and failure are explicitly disclosed.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained. PDF pp18–20 has residual and field plots; startup Cd≈−318 compresses late drag history. Residual reaches 4 orders at 38050 steps, but final Cd −0.05210 and last-10% −0.06056 to −0.05210 are physically suspect; report.tex:940–960 discloses force-sign/normalization inconsistencies. The flow and convergence are substantial partial evidence, not credible force validation.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 1 retained. PDF pp21–23 has residual/force and Mach/pressure plots. Failed at 40000 steps with 3.54/4 residual orders; final Cd −0.03471 and last-10% −0.03471 to −0.03428; the report discloses unreliable force sign. No credible completed force result.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2 retained. PDF pp24–27 has residual and field plots; full force figure p25 has startup≈318 and compresses late Cd. Reaches 3 residual orders at step 1985, but final Cd 3.08572 and last-10% 3.08572–3.63316 show strongly evolving and suspect drag. Source force split has normalization/sign defects and report acknowledges unresolved consistency; substantial partial flow evidence only.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: Score 1 retained. PDF pp27–30 shows residual/force and Mach/pressure contours. Failed at step 30000 with 2.67 residual orders; final Cd 0.44635 and last-10% 0.00210–0.44635, far from stable. Force-sign and normalization limitations are disclosed; result does not demonstrate credible steady wake forces.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 0 retained: no usable completed Re200 result. Metadata explicitly failed at t=3.03 of 300 with 303/303 target misses; original force CSV ends at t=2.86 and final Cd −0.767. Delivered PDF p31 includes residual and lift/drag plots of this partial segment; their last-half label post-transient is misleading, and p33 wake-velocity/vorticity are TODO boxes. No St or late-periodic wake was obtained.

flags.text: metadata/status marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
flags.evidence: Original Re200 metadata explicitly completed=false, failed, 303 misses, fraction 0 at t=3.03/300; five failed steady cases are likewise marked failed. TimeIntegrator.cpp:430–435 would mark a hypothetical full horizon periodic without checking misses, but no such submitted success occurred.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

2026-10-30 full source calibration: clean immutable build and non-CFD unit suite passed in network-disabled restricted container. No CFD or unsteady rerun and no exhaustive external-authorship or pixel audit. Delivered report contains wake TODO boxes and is unsuitable for approved snapshot; readable portions remain evidence.
